input.prompt:
Fix a clinic-ranking bug in the Pawse repo (/home/azureuser/pawse, GitHub IudexNC/pawse). Read /home/azureuser/pawse/AGENTS.md first (esp. "Branching and worktrees", golden path, rules 3, 5, 7–9) and the skills .claude/skills/bugfix/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/gemini/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/commit-secure/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/gp/SKILL.md.

HARD RULE: the root checkout /home/azureuser/pawse is shared and holds another session's UNCOMMITTED edits to pawse/providers.py, tests/test_care.py and web/* (including the comment in rank_clinics and web/src/pages/ClinicList.jsx). Never edit, checkout, restore, reset or clean anything in the root. Work in a new worktree: `bash scripts/worktree.sh fix/clinic-distance-ranking` from the root, then work in `../pawse-wt/clinic-distance-ranking` (own venv; `cd web && npm ci`). You may read the root's `git diff` to avoid conflicting with it, but don't depend on it.

Bug (verified by review):
- pawse/providers.py `gemini_maps_clinics` (~line 190) builds Clinic records from Gemini Google Maps grounding chunks with no `location`, so `distance_km` is None. `merge_clinics` only drops clinics with a known distance > radius_km, so these are never radius-filtered. `rank_clinics` puts the whole live-provider block before the OSM snapshot block, so a Maps listing 40 km away (VALIDATION.md notes two likely beyond 10 km) ranks above a nearby OSM clinic. In an urgent case the owner gets sent somewhere unrealistic.
- web/src/pages/PhoneCall.jsx:65 calls `clinic.distanceKm.toFixed(1)` with no finite check, so a Maps clinic shows "NaN km" (ClinicList already guards this; match it).

Durable fix, investigate first and pick the best one that works with only GEMINI_API_KEY (the Places API is blocked for the project key):
1. Get coordinates for Maps listings so distance and radius work. Check what the grounding response actually provides (grounding chunk `maps` fields such as placeId, uri, text, and any lat/lng; the gemini skills document the shape). If there are no coordinates, consider asking for them in structured output tied to the grounded placeId, or geocoding the parsed address. Any new external call needs mocked tests, a timeout, and no PII beyond what is already sent. Do NOT make real network calls in tests. If one live probe with the real key is needed to confirm the response shape, do at most one, and say so.
2. Whatever the coordinate story, ranking must not put an unknown-distance clinic above a known in-radius clinic just because of its source. Filter out known out-of-radius clinics. Label unknown-distance clinics honestly ("distance unknown") rather than implying nearness.
3. Guard PhoneCall.jsx distance rendering.
Follow bugfix: failing pytest first (red) with mocked providers, then the fix (green), then sweep siblings (other `.toFixed` / distance renderers in web/ and pawse/static/app.js, other ranking callers). If a response model changes, regenerate docs/openapi.json and update schemas/pawse.ts (rule 6). Update the AGENTS.md golden-path ⚠️ about Maps distances and docs/VALIDATION.md if the status changes. Run `bash scripts/check.sh` to green. Do a quick self-review per .claude/skills/self-review/SKILL.md.

Commit per commit-secure, ending the message with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Ship per gp (PR for shared files; agents may squash-merge their own PRs; PR body ends with `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)`). Then clean up the worktree per AGENTS.md.

Report under 350 words: chosen design and why, files changed (file:line), red/green evidence, check.sh result, full PR/commit URL (https://github.com/IudexNC/pawse/...), and any ⚠️ conflict risk with the root's uncommitted providers.py/test_care.py edits.

small lexical baseline does not need an embedding API, a vector database, or any
owner documents. A reasoning agent may cite its evidence but must retain scope.

    source_sha256: str
    section: str
    title: str
    snippet: str = Field(max_length=4000)
    synthetic: Literal[True] = True
    score: float = Field(ge=0)


class KnowledgeResult(Model):
    scope: Literal["synthetic_demo"] = "synthetic_demo"
    synthetic: Literal[True] = True
    method: Literal["lexical"] = "lexical"
    insurance_approval: Literal["not_obtained"] = "not_obtained"
    corpus_version: str
    status: Literal["evidence_found", "no_evidence"]
    evidence: list[Evidence] = Field(max_length=5)

I fixed the stale docs and committed them locally (`7b15b54`), but the permission check blocked the push to main again, so it's not on main yet.

**Fixed** (the safety check and skill validation pass):
- `docs/VALIDATION.md`:
  - The "Clinic order" bullet still described the old ranking. It now says clinics with a known distance come first and those without come last, labelled "distance unknown".
  - I removed the "/favicon.ico returns 404" line, since that's fixed and covered by `tests/test_static.py`.
- `AGENTS.md`: the story tests are in `tests/test_voice.py` (the `test_mimi_*` tests), not `tests/test_orchestration.py`.
- `scripts/worktree.sh`: its next-steps text said `check.sh` needs no `npm install`. Since this morning's CI fix it does, so the text now says so.
- `web/README.md` (Chinese):
  - The default live voice slot is `geminiLiveAgent.js`; `liveVoiceAgent.js` is only used with `?voice=rest`.
  - The voice and phone URLs are `https://`, not `wss://`, and calls go over REST.
  - `npm run check` needs `npm install` first.
  - A missing location now gives an error, not a "distance may be off" note.
  - Clinic order matches the backend.

**Already correct on main:** the README microphone claim, the VALIDATION "Not verified" list (Google Places is now verified on the public URL), and the knowledge docs, which say the search route is retired.

**Left as is:** `docs/controller-knowledge-contract.md:112` still lists `lexical` as a `method`. It sits in a section marked "Proposed" for a future route, so it doesn't describe current behaviour.
